title: Vanilla Sweet Cornish Bacon Full English Breakfast
description: A light and sour British dish featuring vanilla sugar, perfect for a family breakfast. Enjoy the combination of sweet and savory flavors in this Cornish twist on the classic full English breakfast.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the bacon slices until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the bacon from the pan and set aside.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Add the milk, salt, and black pepper to the eggs and whisk until smooth.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook until the eggs are set.
Slice the tomatoes and set aside.
Toast the bread until lightly browned.
Assemble the breakfast by placing a slice of toast on a plate, topping with a slice of bacon, a slice of tomato, and a dollop of scrambled eggs.
Sprinkle a pinch of vanilla sugar on top of the eggs.
